intro: Between 13 April and 14 May 2026, ZCyberNews published 27 articles under the privilege-escalation tag, covering 21 high-severity, 2 medium, and 4 critical incidents. The threat actor Chaotic Eclipse was observed in these campaigns. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2026-34659, CVE-2026-34660, CVE-2026-40372, CVE-2026-4670, and CVE-2026-5174, with two CVEs carrying a CVSS score of 9.6. Affected sectors spanned technology, enterprise, healthcare, education, and financial services, primarily across Global and North American regions.
